== Title ==
<span lang="ja">CZ-3（シーズィー・スリー）</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">CZ-3のいるロケーションか、そこに隣接した位置で 相手が戦闘、フォース消耗を宣言した場合、リアクションとしてそのロケーションにカードを配備できる。配備コストは通常通り支払う。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">サーヴォドロイド社製造のＣＺ通信ドロイド。旧型だが広く使われている。コムリンクを内蔵し 優れたスクランブラーと暗号化機能を持つ。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[CZ-3 (Seezee-Three)]].

'''Lore''' — A CZ communications droid made by Serv-O-Droid Inc. Old model, but still widely used. Built-in comlink, with an excellent scrambler and encryption function.

'''Game text''' — If the opponent initiates a battle or Force drain at CZ-3's location or an adjacent location, you may react by deploying cards there. Pay the usual deploy cost.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
React deploys cards to that location. English deploys them to that battle or Force drain location.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-cz3.gif|Original English face]], [[CZ-3 (Seezee-Three)]].</ref>
